title.narrative: Construction of the Southern Coastal Highway (Phase V) Project

description.narrative: The Project aims at enhancing the connectivity between south Lebanon and the capital Beirut and positively contributing to the socioeconomic development of the South of Lebanon. The completion of the remaining section of the highway (section V) will complete the outcomes of the completed sections of the highway, namely, enhanced accessibility to villages in the south, serving agricultural areas and providing better market access, in addition to relieving the actual old coastal road from the heavy traffic congestion and reducing traffic accidents.
